summary: Iteration 4 re-verified the billing trial-days bug fix. BACKEND: 9/9 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_billing_stripe.py — including the new regression `test_billing_status_trial_days_left_positive` which asserts GET /api/billing/status returns 1<=trial_days_left<=14 and entitled=true. Manual curl against the demo account now returns {"status":"trial","entitled":true,"trial_days_left":13,...} (previously 0/false). The pre-existing 8 billing tests (auth guards, status shape, checkout → Stripe URL, verify-unpaid keeps trial, verify requires session_id, webhook unsigned-accept + idempotent, webhook malformed=400) all still pass — no regressions. FRONTEND(web 1280x900): logged in as demo@petadmin.app, navigated to More tab. With subscription_status reset to 'trial' the billing-card renders exactly '13 days of trial left / Add a card to keep PetAdmin after your trial. / Upgrade' (NOT 'Trial ended / Subscribe'). With status='trialing' it renders the paid-plan variant '[billing-manage] Pro — in free trial / 13 days left in your trial / Manage'. Both branches correctly reflect the fixed trial_days_left. Fix location confirmed at /app/backend/server.py:912-913: `if end.tzinfo is None: end = end.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` before the subtraction. Deprecated packages detected: none.

minor.issue: The except Exception: days_left = 0 fallback still silently masks any future datetime parsing errors. Non-blocking since the tz fix is in place, but prefer `except (TypeError, ValueError)` with a log line so the next regression surfaces in logs.

action_items: (optional / low priority) Narrow the broad `except Exception` in _subscription_summary to (TypeError, ValueError) and add a logger.exception call so a similar tz-naive regression would be observable in backend logs instead of silently returning days_left=0.

(optional) Consider initialising AsyncIOMotorClient with tz_aware=True so BSON datetimes round-trip tz-aware everywhere in server.py (defence-in-depth; the local replace(tzinfo=UTC) already fixes this specific endpoint).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:904-927 _subscription_summary — fix is correct and minimal; recommend logging the tz coercion only in debug to avoid noise.
server.py:51 AsyncIOMotorClient still created without tz_aware=True; any future endpoint doing date math on Mongo datetimes risks the same class of bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — billing-card copy correctly shows '13 days of trial left / Upgrade' for status=trial and 'Pro — in free trial / Manage' for status=trialing

seed_data_creation: Reused demo@petadmin.app. One-off Mongo update ran to flip the user's subscription_status back to 'trial' (it was left as 'trialing' by the iter3 webhook test) so the frontend could exercise the trial billing-card branch. Final state: status='trial', trial_ends_at=~13 days out.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Billing trial-days-left bug is fully fixed and regression-locked. New assertion lives at /app/backend/tests/test_billing_stripe.py::test_billing_status_trial_days_left_positive. Demo user is currently in subscription_status='trial' with 13 trial_days_left. Frontend More-tab testIDs: billing-card (trial branch, Upgrade CTA) and billing-manage (trialing/active branch, Manage CTA). Both now behave correctly.
rca_of_issue: Bug (iter3) was in server.py _subscription_summary: Mongo returned trial_ends_at as a naive datetime; datetime.fromisoformat on its ISO string returned naive; the subtraction `end - now_utc()` raised TypeError which the broad except swallowed → days_left=0, entitled=False, UI showed 'Trial ended / Subscribe'. FIX APPLIED by main agent at server.py:911-913: after fromisoformat, if end.tzinfo is None → end = end.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc). VERIFIED: GET /api/billing/status now returns trial_days_left=13, entitled=true; More-tab billing-card now shows '13 days of trial left / Upgrade'.
